tests.name: Example
tests.setup:
h = BrowserHistory("leetcode.com")
for url in ["google.com", "facebook.com", "youtube.com"]:
    h.visit(url)
out = [h.back(1), h.back(1), h.forward(1)]
h.visit("linkedin.com")
out += [h.forward(2), h.back(2), h.back(7)]

tests.name: visit clears forward history
tests.setup:
h = BrowserHistory("a")
h.visit("b"); h.visit("c"); h.back(2); h.visit("d")
tests.hint: After visit, there are no forward pages any more.

tests.name: Back and forward clamp at the ends
100 000 calls
tests.expr: (len(out), out[-5:], sum(len(u) for u in out))
